provenance.what: A real goldens/overflow_warnings.json, captured verbatim. The left-hand side of #1339's offline comparison.
provenance.frozen: records[] and logs[] must NEVER be regenerated. They are the recorded output of the parser #1339 deleted, so regenerating them with the shared parser would make the comparison compare the new parser against itself and pass unconditionally.
provenance.width: screen1080 — golden CI's third coordinate, added 2026-08-24. The two committed coordinates (phone480, desktop1280) produce no overflow at all, which is why this had to be captured at a width no baseline exists for.
provenance.notMultiSide: All 16 records carry exactly one 'pixels on the <side>' clause, so the first-side -> worst-side difference cannot arise anywhere in this corpus. That is the finding, not a gap: the difference is pinned separately, against a real two-sided SDK string, in overflow_record_test.dart.
